bib.title: Imagine while Reasoning in Space: Multimodal Visualization-of-Thought

question: Can a multimodal LLM improve spatial reasoning by generating image visualizations of its intermediate reasoning states, instead of reasoning in text only?
hypothesis: Interleaving generated visual thoughts with verbal thoughts helps spatial reasoning where text-only CoT fails, as in human dual-coding cognition.
contributions: Propose Multimodal Visualization-of-Thought (MVoT), a multimodal native reasoning paradigm unifying text and vision in the reasoning traces
Implement MVoT in Chameleon-7B (Anole-7B) and introduce token discrepancy loss in autoregressive MLLMs
Comprehensive experiments and ablations across three spatial reasoning tasks with newly collected datasets

method.summary: Anole-7B is LoRA fine-tuned to emit, after each verbal reasoning step, an image of the new environment state, conditioning later steps on it. Loss is cross-entropy over text and image tokens plus a token discrepancy loss L_D that penalises probability on image tokens far from the label in visual-embedding space. Compared against Direct, text CoT, Interleaved and GPT-4o on three grid tasks.
method.task: dynamic spatial reasoning (Maze destination, MiniBehavior InstallingAPrinter outcome, FrozenLake outcome) as multiple-choice QA

datasets.name: MAZE (maze-dataset)
datasets.split: train/dev; grid sizes 3-6; dev called test in Table 1
datasets.source: generated with maze-dataset library [ISS+23], iterative DFS
datasets.preprocessing: repeated paths removed; three random distractor destinations added

datasets.name: MINIBEHAVIOR (InstallingAPrinter)
datasets.split: train/dev; grid sizes in Table 1 5-8, Table 6 says 7-10
datasets.preprocessing: successful sequences retained; layouts modified with 40% printer/table coordinate change each, 20% removal

datasets.name: FROZENLAKE
datasets.source: Gym environments and scripts from VSP [WZS+24], Q-table agents
datasets.preprocessing: failed sequences: hole falls saved as-is 50% or with appended random actions 50%

models.name: Anole-7B
models.architecture: autoregressive unified decoder transformer (Chameleon), discrete image tokens
models.tokenizer: Chameleon image tokenizer (VQ, [ERO21]) plus text tokenizer, both frozen

models.name: MVoT / Direct / CoT / Interleaved variants of Anole-7B

training.objective: L = L_C + L_D; L_C cross-entropy on text and image tokens, L_D = sum_i S_{t_i} . P(t_i) with S the MSE distances between visual codebook embeddings; loss only on predicted outputs
training.batch_size: train batch size 4, grad accumulation 4 (Direct, CoT) or 2 (Interleaved, MVoT)
training.regularisation: input augmentation: tokenize-detokenize the input image a random 0-10 times during MVoT training

other.LoRA: LoRA used on part of parameters; rank, alpha, target modules not stated

inference.samples: single run per item; no seeds or intervals reported
inference.prompting: fine-tuned models use task instruction plus image; GPT-4o zero-shot Direct, zero-shot CoT ('Let's think step by step'), and ReAct-style with MVoT visual thoughts supplied by fine-tuned Anole one action at a time

metrics.name: Accuracy
metrics.definition: answer extracted by pattern matching 'the answer is', compared with ground-truth choice

metrics.name: V-Acc.
metrics.definition: accuracy of visualizing the intended modification in the grid for the next action

metrics.name: V-Red.
metrics.definition: presence of unintended patterns outside the targeted modification region

metrics.name: V-Steps
metrics.definition: average length of the first k consecutive correct visualizations in an action sequence

metrics.name: V-Ratio
metrics.definition: average proportion of first k consecutive correct visualizations across the sequence

eval.protocol: single run, test split; visualization metrics only for Maze and MiniBehavior agent position; Fig 5 uses 800 random examples; no significance tests

prompts.text:
Task: Maze Navigation Simulation
Determine the final destination (A, B, C or D) from the starting point (red point) following the action sequence. The definitions of the actions are as below.
* Go up/left/down/right: move one grid space in the absolute up/left/down/right direction.
Full Action Sequence: Go down. Go left. Go left. Go up. Go up.
Initial maze: <image>
Let’s think step by step. Conclude your final answer between <ANSWER>and </ANSWER >.

prompts.purpose: GPT-4o with MVoT plug-in, system part (MiniBehavior)
prompts.text: To predict the consequence of a sequence of actions, you need to simulate the action sequence with ‘one action‘ at a time. Each time after simulating one action, ‘your turn is finished‘ and you should wait for the environment to provide the corresponding image observation.
prompts.where: Appendix C.2, Table 14 (rest of template in paper)

limits: Generated visualizations often reconstruct task-irrelevant details (FrozenLake background) and overlook the intended change (authors).
Explicit image generation adds inference compute overhead (authors).
Three synthetic grid tasks only; one 7B backbone; single seed; no confidence intervals.
CoT with layout beats MVoT on Maze and MiniBehavior; MVoT wins only on FrozenLake.
Visualization metrics not reported for FrozenLake because automatic evaluation is hard.
Anole LoRA rank, optimizer, LR schedule, precision not stated; no code release stated.
GPT-4o with MVoT is a ReAct-style pipeline with Anole supplying images, not a single model.
Training uses golden previous images; inference recursive on generated images (exposure gap).

terms.definition: Loss that minimizes the discrepancy between predictions and labels in visual embedding space, weighting predicted token probabilities by embedding distance to the ground-truth token
training on interleaved text-image data with loss only on text tokens
